mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a cool 56 degrees with clear skies, providing perfect visibility for a look at the New Moon. If you look up tonight at 7:40 PM, you can catch the International Space Station crossing the sky for one minute, traveling from the west southwest near Mount Horeb toward the northeast near the Home Depot.

In city news, police were called to Hunter's Cove Way on September 10th following a report of a burglary in progress. An officer located the suspect, a 19-year-old from Madison, who was taken into custody after a handgun was recovered. No injuries were reported from the firearm discharge, and the suspect faces charges of burglary and reckless safety endangerment.

There is plenty to do this week. Today, the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival takes over the town, while live music is featured at both Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, yoga is scheduled for tomorrow at Insight Wellness, and next week features trivia at Hop Haus, the Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus the downtown farmer's market on Tuesday.
Regarding the local police report, on September 10th, officers successfully apprehended an offender involved in a residential burglary and weapons offence on Hunter's Cove Way.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Really Reese's. Culver's is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM to serve you.
